title: Integrate released Tactus lifecycle APIs and verify latency
description: Upgrade the Tactus dependency, remove runtime method replacement, prewarm the Console model stack, correct latency metrics, keep tool context compact, and verify locally plus in the sandbox before production approval.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Verification also found one remaining DSPy ToolCall compatibility monkeypatch in the procedure executor. It must be removed and covered by the owned Tactus object-shape support before this integration task is complete.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Integrated the local Tactus branch through supported APIs only: removed the remaining Tactus/DSPy method and ToolCall monkeypatches, prewarmed the configured Console model, disabled redundant per-turn steering reads through supported Agent configuration, and replaced misleading model timing with lifecycle phases. Corrected the built-in procedure registry/config version to 1.6.32. Focused Plexus verification passes: 346 tests. Sandbox browser benchmark: 7.596s fresh, 7.268s mean across ten warm turns, down from 15.155s; provider first chunk normally 1.65-2.1s and no request-time LM initialization. Awaiting the reviewed Tactus patch release before locking Plexus to the released artifact and running the full Python CI matrix.
